question: When and where is the three-laksha japa said?
premises: at rising, at union, in peace — three-laksha japa is said
in mouth, in going-coming, in thread
inference: Triple occasion, triple locus: rising/union/peace; mouth/course/thread; hamsa and pair.
plain_english: At rising, at union, in peace — three-laksha japa is said; in mouth, in going-coming, in thread, in hamsa-named, in Shaiva pair.
